details.description: Nous Hermes Llama2 7B is a 7-billion-parameter chat model that Nous Research fine-tuned from Meta's Llama 2 7B base, on more than 300,000 mostly GPT-4-generated synthetic instructions spanning general chat, roleplay, and code. It uses an Alpaca-style prompt format and is released as an open-weight model under the MIT license, the smallest of Nous Research's Hermes-Llama2 line. Nous Research's own model card lists Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-8B as this model's successor.
advantages: Scores a 68.6% average on the GPT4All benchmark suite, per its model card.
Scores 79.76% accuracy on PIQA, per its model card.
Its model card reports long responses, a lower hallucination rate, and no OpenAI-style censorship mechanisms in its training data.
disadvantages: English-language training data only, per its model card.
Its model card reports lower performance on logical reasoning and specialized knowledge domains than the larger Hermes-Llama2 models.
4,096-token training context, short next to more recent chat models.
Nous Research's own model card designates Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-8B as this model's successor version, indicating it has been superseded.

notes: Only the Hugging Face model card was available; no separate maker docs page or host listing was found. GPT4All, BigBench, and AGIEval averages were converted from the card's 0-1 fractions to a 0-100 scale. The card links a Discord-bot example repo, not a repository for the model itself, so github_url is left null.
